messages:
celine: Heads-up, release cut is blocked. deploy-bot refused promotion citing an artifact-index-drift: published artifact index lists different blob set than registry manifest for redwood/inference:canary-20260323.

buildkite: CI publish step logs: 'artifact index written: index_id=ix-20260323-7, checksum=sha256:9f3e' at 09:09:52Z. registry manifest push returned digest sha256:9f3e, but post-sync registry index shows checksum sha256:8a2b for same tag.

deploy-bot: system: promotion halted - artifact-index-drift detected for tag 'canary-20260323'. automatic promotion inhibited. Lock owner: deploy-bot.

omar: Does this look like a concurrent publish / index rewrite? Could be two CI runners hitting publish near-simultaneously or a cache writeback race in the indexer.

jen: Looking through the CI job: job 7782 retried a post-upload index update after a transient S3 503. The retry appears to have created a new index object with the same tag but different blob list. That's likely the drift.

sre-bot: Note: change window opens in ~40m. Options: (A) pin promotion to manifest digest sha256:9f3e (fast) and run smoke; (B) rollback the tag to the previous canary and rebuild (safe but delays window); (C) re-run index reconciliation job then allow auto-promote once consistent.

celine: We need fastest safe path. Pinning risks some hosts reading the older index from CDN cache and failing to fetch blobs if index->manifest mismatch exists. Is the index referenced by runtime or only used at build time?

omar: The index is used by our release tool to resolve image digests in some shards. Runtime uses manifests directly, but some edge infra pulls index from the CDN for prefetch. If CDN has stale index we could route some prefetchers to the wrong blob set. That could cause transient 404s.

jen: Reconcile job (infra-indexer) can run now and should converge in ~5-10m. But that still blocks the window unless we accept manual pin and smoke.

sre-bot: Risk matrix: manual pin + regional smoke -> medium-low risk (some prefetch 404s possible but no user-facing impact for this canary). Rebuild -> delays window by ~90m. Reconcile -> 5-10m but uncertain.

celine: Given canary traffic is internal and we want to keep the change window, recommend: run index reconciliation now, if reconciliation completes in <8m promote automatically, else perform manual pin to primary digest sha256:9f3e and run targeted smoke (eu-west 3 replicas + cdn prefetch test). Postmortem / infra ticket mandatory.

omar: I'll kick the reconcile job now and monitor. Logs: reconcile started at 09:15:10Z. comparing index objects ix-20260323-7 (9f3e) vs ix-20260323-7 (8a2b). Reconciler attempting to copy missing blobs to mirror and re-generate a canonical index.

buildkite: reconcile progress: copied 2/12 blobs to mirror, then hit transient 503 on third blob, retried and succeeded. Reconciler reports canonical checksum now sha256:9f3e at 09:20:05Z.

sre-bot: reconcile succeeded and registry index checksum matches primary manifest (sha256:9f3e). Auto-promotion gate re-evaluating.

deploy-bot: system: promotion validation passed after index reconciliation. Promotion resumed automatically. promo-id=promo-1749007777-1.

jen: Running targeted smoke: eu-west 3 replicas + CDN prefetch check. Prefetch HEADs for top blobs returning 200 from edge nodes. Replica pulls successful.

celine: Unblocked release window. Creating infra ticket INFRA-2222: "artifact indexer retry idempotency and index-write ordering" and adding runbook step to verify index checksums across mirrors before promotion.

sre-bot: Ticket INFRA-2222 created. Also adding follow-up: ensure reconcile job triggers automatically when deploy-bot detects index drift.

omar: Thanks team. Closing this thread — release proceeds. :rocket:
